source_descriptor.clock_follow_basis: nominal affine; remote corrections are not supplied to receiver

power.data_reference_scope: fixed public bit0; at most16 stratified keyed tiles with2048 fractional nodes each; active-time mean omits finite outer halo; between-tile standard error is diagnostic, not a confidence bound or integration guarantee; one unchanged gain for the entire stream

source_descriptor.basis_scope: Public DATA pattern only; arrival is absolute seconds in the requested observation coordinate. Fixed key/epoch per session; all three carriers retained.
source_descriptor.scope: Bounded pull source, not a receiver or real-time guarantee. Emitted kind has no channel or thermal noise. Physical null and full-duration power accuracy require qualification.

spectral_certificate.method: independent-zero-mean-coefficient finite-kernel energy spectrum; pulse/gate FFT with endpoint corrections
spectral_certificate.limitation: Expected emitted DATA energy, not compact support or a worst-key/channel bound. Residual tails remain emitted; receiver filtering/channel tails are unchanged. Sampling and phase-quadrature checks are engineering diagnostics.

physics.random_doppler_width_definition: B=2sigma of each ray Gaussian spectrum; independent of ray center separation
physics.selective_depth_definition: bounded sinusoidal peak excursion; component RMS depth/sqrt(2)
physics.delay_motion_doppler_bound_scope: nominal carrier plus entire source Nyquist interval; includes envelope time-warp as well as propagation phase
physics.random_sampling_policy: fixed physical-time knots at16*B; variance-normalized cubic interpolation; stationary indexed innovations independent of receiver sample rate and chunk boundaries
physics.random_spectral_allowance_scope: engineering spectral-tail allowance, not compact support or a physical measurement; delay-motion Doppler is additional and is counted once
physics.cn0_scope: nominal active DATA reference and effective production Helper/DATA power ratio; actual finite-calendar component energies are reported separately

export_constraints.sampled_duration_constraint: No time cap; sampled export byte budget and chosen power-reference work budget remain enforced.
export_constraints.plan_only_duration_limit: checked uint64 geometry with no sampled-duration cap

limitations: This is a key-independent expected-energy shaping certificate, not a worst-case encrypted pattern or sampled channel bound.
The selected sampler and explicit export budget reject unsupported geometries; planner-only results do not imply receiver availability.
Source capture still retains the conservative 2/ramp envelope bound and complete physical channel tails.

source_energy.scope: Complete emitted or channel DATA+Helper including native thermal noise; no per-realization normalization; not DATA-only when Helper on
